anomalies_found_and_fixed: Stripped Gutenberg license header/footer, the full front-of-book Table of Contents (a redundant listing of every discourse title), and Elizabeth Foerster-Nietzsche's editorial Introduction essay.

Stripped Anthony M. Ludovici's translator commentary 'APPENDIX: Notes on Thus Spake Zarathustra' at the very end -- this is the translator's own critical essay discussing the text discourse-by-discourse, not part of Nietzsche's novel; kept the novel through its final line ('...like a morning sun coming out of gloomy mountains.').
Merged 112 standalone numbered-subsection marker line(s) (e.g. the '1.'/'2.' numbering inside Zarathustra's Prologue and other discourses) into the start of the following paragraph.

FIRST/SECOND/THIRD/FOURTH PART and each of the ~80 individual discourse titles (e.g. 'ZARATHUSTRA'S PROLOGUE.', 'THE THREE METAMORPHOSES.') are recognized as chapter-level headings, giving fine-grained chaptering matching the book's natural discourse structure.
